| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(4)` | `3` |   | VRRP version (2 = RFC 3768, 3 = RFC 5798). |

| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum with pseudo header over the header and everything after it | Internet checksum over the VRRP message (VRRPv3 includes the IP pseudo header) (Auto). |
| `ip_addresses` | `list<ipv4>` — `count_ipvx_addrs * 4` octets | 1 items |   | Virtual router addresses. |
